text:
samir: Heads up — FinOptic (large fintech) asking for a bespoke commercial. They want 40% off list on a 12mo commit. POC went well, want to sign this quarter. Need deal-desk review before EoW.
alicia: What is the target ARR / committed spend? and are they asking for any special terms?
samir: Asking for $1.2M committed spend (annualized). Also wants a clause for data residency + longer support hours. They said competitor quote is ~35% off + onboarding credits.
jordan: 40% is big. Need business justifier: rationale, competitor comp, referenceability, logo value, migration complexity, expected ARR growth. Also margin check from finance. Can you paste a short proposal?
samir: Proposal pasted below:
```
Customer: FinOptic
Commit: 12 months
Committed ARR: $1.2M
Requested discount: 40% off list for Hosted API + embeddings
Add-ons: 24/7 support, data residency in us-east, 1 FTE onboarding credit ($120k)
POC status: success (latency + cost targets met)
Reference: yes (case study agreed)
Go-live: planned <60 days
```
(alicia: pinging legal for residency clause)
mia: Quick finance sanity check — with 40% off plus onboarding credit, effective margin gets tight. 35% + $100k credit likely borderline but acceptable if committed ARR / term guaranteed and referenceable. 40% requires exec sign-off (cto/cfo).
deal-desk: Please fill the deal desk form with TCV, expected start date, and attach the POC report. Also include which models/features are in-scope and any SLA deviations. Link: https://internal/deal-desk/form
samir: Done — form submitted (ID: DD-6721). Attached POC perf logs and security note. Asking for a quick review before Friday call.
jordan: Reviewed DD-6721. Recommendation: counteroffer structure to preserve unit economics: Option A = 35% off list + $100k onboarding credit + 12-month irrevocable commit. Option B = 30% off list with usage tiering that unlocks an extra 5% at $1.6M net ARR. Both require published reference and standard SLAs (no SLA relax). Which do you want to present?
samir: FinOptic prefers simpler terms — they'd accept Option A if we can confirm data residency and extended support.
legal-bot: Residency + support SOW needs to be drafted; standard addendum will cover it. No unusual IP or indemnity asks in the thread so far.
mia: Finance approves Option A conditionally: 35% + $100k credit, provided legal signs the residency addendum and we get an approved case study within 90 days. Otherwise escalate to execs.
jordan: Deal-desk status: APPROVED_CONDITIONAL (35% + $100k credit, 12mo irrevocable commit, reference clause, residency addendum). I'll update the internal approval ticket and loop contracts. Please don't verbal-sign until we have executed SOW.
alicia: Great — Samir, present Option A on the call and note exec escalation path if customer pushes to 40%. Also confirm timeline for signed addendum and case study.
samir: Got it. I'll present Option A and push for signature this week. Thanks all :thumbsup:
